content.raw:
Next Gen. Industrial Partner

PT Surya Inovasi Prioritas

SURIOTA is a technology company specializing in Industrial IoT & System Integration, headquartered in Batam, Riau Islands. Since January 2023, we have delivered 64+ industrial projects - from Modbus gateways to complete IoT platforms across manufacturing, energy, logistics, and maritime sectors.

Our 5 Core Services

01

Industrial IoT & System Integration

End-to-end Industrial IoT. Modbus gateway, MQTT, edge computing, SCADA, sensor-to-cloud pipelines with IEC 62443 security for manufacturing, oil & gas, and maritime operations.
02

AI & Industrial Analytics

Predictive maintenance, OEE dashboards, computer-vision QC, and real-time operational intelligence. Turning raw machine data into actionable plant-floor decisions.
03

Digital Transformation Consulting

Industry 4.0 roadmap, OT/IT convergence assessment, IIoT readiness audit, SCADA modernization, and cloud migration strategy for Indonesian manufacturers.
04

Industrial Engineering & Automation

PLC integration, SCADA modernization, Solar PV PLTS design, hybrid PLTS-PLTB systems, and smart street light (PJU). Turnkey industrial energy transition.
05

SURGE SaaS Platform

SURGE multi-tenant IoT platform. Energy Mapping (kWh, power factor), Water Analytic (KLHK SPARING compliance), Vessel Tracking (fleet + fuel monitoring).

With our commitment to the highest technical standards, SURIOTA is a trusted partner in improving efficiency, productivity, and business sustainability for clients across Indonesia.
